tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search Kitbay's directory of MCP servers and agent skills by text, or browse by tool, category or AI client. Returns facts per listing (official, can change data, needs credentials, licence, last activity) and its Kitbay page. Needs a query, tool, category or client.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Is there an MCP server or skill for a tool (e.g. Figma, Blender, Notion), and is one official? Returns the tool's counts, its official listings and its Kitbay page, or suggestions when Kitbay does not cover it.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: All facts Kitbay holds for one MCP server or skill, each with its source URL and checked date: publisher, official, can change data, needs credentials, connection, licence, repository, packages, latest version, last commit, archived.

tools.name: get_install_config
tools.description: How to add one MCP server or skill to one AI client, taken from the project's own documentation, with where the config goes. Credentials are placeholders, never real values. Clients: claude-code, claude-desktop, cursor, vscode, codex, chatgpt, gemini-cli, windsurf, cline, zed. Show the user the snip

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Kitbay's categories (two levels) and general capabilities, with counts, for browsing with search_listings (pass a category or capability slug as category). totals gives Kitbay's headline counts and everything search reaches; category counts cover only listings linked to a tool.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
